title: The document save reads the store's erase mark as the batch starts, not an erase the caller hands it
evidence: Done 2026-11-25 (R5 PR 2): bulkSaveDocuments, which read this.shownErase as the batch started, had no production caller and left the store (copy for tests in widget-src/src/testing/bulk-save.ts). The live document save is the upload's saveUploadThrough, which takes the erase from the flow's saving state, read at the press on Save (see H18). Was: storage/roadmap-store.ts:428 const erase = this.shownErase R5 PR 3 (2026-11-25): the erase is a required argument by type on every RoadmapStore and lib/roadmap-data.ts writer, on RecordSession.refuses and .edit (packages/health-core/src/record-session.ts: the fallback default `erase = this.shownErase` is gone), and on the web upload Save's state (storage/upload-save-store.ts WebSaving; the phone's door still omits it). A writer that forgets it does not compile: storage/roadmap-store-erase-argument.test.ts `writersRequireAnErase` (one @ts-expect-error per writer) and its table (each writer under an older erase refused, record JSON unchanged; under the shown erase it lands).
